notes.title: Bug Fix Update v1.0.6 (August 1)
notes.content:
Thank you for playing hololive GoroGoro Mountain!

We’ve released update v1.0.6, which includes the following improvements and bug fixes:


[hr][/hr]

Update Details
Fixed an issue where WASD keys could remain continuously pressed when playing with a keyboard in certain environments.

This issue had previously been addressed, but was found to persist under some conditions. We’ve re-identified the cause and implemented a fix.

Fixed a bug where the game window could become larger than the screen when using a high resolution in windowed mode.


[hr][/hr]

Other Fixes
Adjusted parts of the UI.

Adjusted some in-game sound effects.

Fixed minor bugs.


[hr][/hr]

Known Issues (Under Investigation)
We are aware of an issue where random matchmaking in multiplayer can be difficult to complete.

Our team is actively working on a fix, and we appreciate your patience until it is resolved.




[hr][/hr]


We’ll continue working to make the game even smoother and more enjoyable!

Thank you for your continued support of hololive GoroGoro Mountain.

notes.title: Demo Update Announcement
notes.content:
Thank you to everyone who’s shared feedback with us!



Based on the comments we’ve received during the ongoing Steam Next Fest,

we’ve updated the hololive GoroGoro Mountain demo to make it even easier and more fun to play!


Update Details
Removed the angle adjustment via long press when throwing, making it quicker and easier to throw treasures.

Relaxed the time limit for Normal stages to improve playability.

We’ll continue improving the experience throughout the festival so that more players can enjoy the thrill of our rolling action.

Be sure to check out the updated demo and give it a try!

notes.title: Now Available: Free Demo of hololive GOROGORO MOUNTAIN
notes.content:
hololive GoroGoro Mountain – Free Demo Now Available on Steam!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45530816/5ef194144839350c0212b1e9081d1981d5720efb.png

Time to climb a mountain!?  
The free demo of hololive GoroGoro Mountain, a lively 3D action game where you roll adorable treasures to the goal for Captain Houshou Marine, is now available on Steam!

hololive GoroGoro Mountain is a fun and playful 3D puzzle-action game starring the popular hololive VTuber Houshou Marine.

The demo includes two stages: a “Normal” stage to learn the basics, and a “Hard” stage for a true challenge.  
Roll, throw, and strategize your way to the goal—experience the full joy of GoroGoro Action!

▼ Roll for your Oshi! Push Captain Marine to the top!  
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45530816/6d20f54c29e94b53fb2eae7ea9e97e0005e975fa.png

You’ll join the crew as a loyal Ichimi (Captain Marine’s fan) and roll treasures based on hololive members…

Each treasure has a unique shape and rolling style depending on the talent—mastering the controls won’t be easy!  
Will it roll off the edge? Fly in a strange direction? Unexpected twists await on this chaotic climb!

▼ Throw it for a game-changing move!  
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45530816/f084365602befb3d7acf56eea050efa1308a69ba.png

In this game, you don’t just roll—you can throw the treasures too!  
Plot your route and take it slow, or go bold with a high-flying shortcut.  
The key to success lies in your creativity and daring spirit!

▼ A wild ride with chattering treasures!

The treasures are as lively as ever!  
Just like in the previous title, hololive Treasure Mountain, every roll or throw comes with cheerful voice lines—cheering you on, teasing, or cracking a joke mid-climb!

▼ Try the free special stages now!

Sometimes you roll, sometimes you throw—join the Ichimi and aim for the top with Captain Marine!  
Try the demo today and experience the chaos and charm of hololive GoroGoro Mountain!
